pattern: Image with a text alternative: role=img on the host, aria-label with the name and presence status.

roles.role: presentation (alt is empty; the host carries the name)

aria.value: the name, or 'name, status' when a status is shown

aria.element: host when decorative; visual and status dot always

keyboard.action: Not focusable; read in document order by assistive technology.

notes: Presence is part of the accessible name and has a distinct shape per status, not only a color.
Set decorative when the person's name is printed next to the avatar, so it is not read twice.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
